exposure: transport profile (services level, type of ambulance)
clinical features at admission (e.g., reason for referral like sepsis, shock, DIC)
cohort: The study included 59 outborn neonates consecutively admitted to a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found a 10% mortality rate among outborn neonates, with shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), and a SNAPPEII score exceeding 40 at admission significantly associated with mortality.
cross-section timing: During admission to the tertiary care hospital
